## family guy galley

```{r helpers}
resolve_src <-function(path){
  if (grepl("^https?://", path)){
    return(path)
  } else {
    return(knitr::image_uri(path))
  }
}
# MagicK is being used to force     every thumbnail to be the same crop/size
process_thumb <- function(path, width = 300, height = 300){
  img <- image_read(path)
  img <- image_resize(img, glue("{width}x{height}^"))
  img <- image_crop(img, glue("{width}x{height}"), gravity = "center")
  tmp <- tempfile(fileext = ".jpg")
  image_write(img, tmp, format = "jpg")
  knitr::image_uri(tmp)
  
}

tags$head(tags$style(HTML("
  body { scroll-behavior: smooth; }
  .hero-wrapper { position: relative; margin-bottom: 30px; }
  .hero-strip {
    display: flex; overflow-x: scroll; scroll-snap-type: x mandatory;
    -webkit-overflow-scrolling: touch; padding: 15px 0; scrollbar-width: none;
  }
  .hero-strip::-webkit-scrollbar {display: none; }
  .hero-strip img{
  height: 260px; width: 220px; object-fit: cover;
  scroll-snap-align: start; flex: 0 0 auto; margin-right: 14px;
  border-radius: 10px; box-shadow: 0 2px 6px rgba(0,0,0,0.2);
  transition: transform 0.2s ease, box-shadow 0.2s ease;
  }
  .hero-strip img:hover {transfrom: scale(1.06); box-shadow: 0 6px 16px rgba(0, 0,0,0.35);}
  .hero-arrow {
  position: absolute; top: 50% transform: translateY(-50%);
  background: rgba(0,0,0,0.55); color: white; border: none;
  width: 40px; height: 40px; border-radius: 50%; cursor: pointer; font-size: 20px; z-index: 10;
  
  }
  .hero-arrow.left { left: 0px; } .hero-arrow.right { right: 0px; }
")))
```
```{r ui server}
ui <- fluidPage(
  div(
    class = "hero-wrapper",
    tags$button(class = "herro-arrow left",
                onclick = "document.getElementById('spongeStrip').scrollBy({left: -500, behavior: 'smooth'})",
                HTML("&#8249;")),
    div(
      id = "spongeStrip", class = "hero-strip",
      lapply(sponge_images, function(src){
        tags$img(src= process_thumb(src))
      })
    ),
    tags$button(class = "hero-arrow right",
                onclick = "document.getElementById('spongeStrip').scrollBy({left: 250, behavior: 'smooth'})",
                )
  )
)

server <- function(input, output, session){
  # No server logic needed for pure display gallery
}
shinyApp(ui, server)
```
